methodology.bots_layman: Each seat runs a different play style (cautious, aggressive, alliance-focused, etc.) with smart dice/card choices — not random.
methodology.purpose: Simulate intentional play styles to stress-test cards and kingmaking rules.
methodology.developer_note: Sweep uses agents.heuristic seat_bots + smart_choice_policy. Training rotates PPO updates across all seats.

training_choices_note.layman: Balance sweeps use smart heuristic choices for every seat. During training, each seat gets its own learned policy that picks cards and dice branches; opponents still use heuristics with smart choices.
training_choices_note.trained_seat: Rotates across all seats when train_all_seats is true. Policy picks play indices and choice branches.

headlines.assisted_layman: In 3% of games, the winner had received gifted gold during the game. Lower is better — high values suggest kingmaking or runaway gifts.
headlines.shield_layman: Protection guesses resolved correctly 50% of the time; shields blocked attacks 1% of plays.
headlines.role_layman: The player who started as King won 34% of games; Nobles who started behind won 66%.

kingmaker.layman: We tested a rigged scenario: a losing player gifts gold to a friend. Without the earned-gold rule, that friend becomes King 100% of the time. With the rule, it drops to 0%.

signoff_comparison.reason: Both pass equally; prefer 385 games for statistical sign-off per PRD.

recommendations: Assisted win rate 12.99% exceeds max 12.00%; reducing betrayal/theft gold amounts by 9%.
Negotiation gift cap lowered 78 -> 70 to reduce kingmaking gifts.

metric_explanations.seat_position_win_rate: How often each starting seat wins. Uneven rates may mean a seating bug.
metric_explanations.role_win_rate: Win rate for players who started as King vs Noble. Shows if starting role is unfair.
metric_explanations.card_pick_rate: How often a card gets played when it could be. Low = dead card; very high = auto-include.
metric_explanations.card_win_contribution: Win rate in games where this card was played, vs overall. High = possible overperformer.
metric_explanations.card_win_contribution_by_role: Win rate split by whether the player was King or Noble when the card was played. Use this before nerfing — raw contribution confounds role with card power.
metric_explanations.assisted_win_rate: Games where the winner's person received negotiation gold_gifted events (to_person == winner_person).
metric_explanations.assisted_win_modes: Why assisted wins happened (stacking, starting king gifts, etc.).
metric_explanations.shield_hit_rate: Protection trigger resolved as a correct guess at end of playing phase.
metric_explanations.shield_block_rate: Active shields that actually blocked an attack (shield_blocked events).
metric_explanations.whiff_penalty_rate: Protection guesses that whiffed and triggered on_whiff_penalty.
metric_explanations.protection_net_ev: Average gold swing per protection card play (hits and whiffs combined).
metric_explanations.skill_gap: How much trained bots beat random bots. Too low = no skill; too high = no room for luck.
metric_explanations.exploitability: How much a sharp counter-strategy beats your policy. Lower means harder to exploit.
metric_explanations.promise_keep_rate: Alliances and conditional promises kept vs broken. Tests negotiation meaning.
